decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's decorative wooden gift line that also fits its move toward combining craftsmanship with technology, this product should be retained while results are still uncertain and there is no clear sign it falls below aspiration levels.

This nativity stable sits squarely in the firm's established seasonal woodcraft business, so in a growing industry and without evidence of underperformance management would keep it as comfortably above or near aspiration.

The modern incense smoker figurine is near the core offer and supports the firm's stated aim of refreshing traditional designs, so boundedly rational management would continue it unless clearer negative feedback emerged.
